$comment: MVP's roadmap as the docs described it on 2026-09-29 (docs/HANDOFF.md, decisions.md, architecture.md, riot-application.md, policy.md, and the commits), written by Claude for mvp-roadmap. Imported only into an empty database (mvp-roadmap seed, or the server's first start); after that the roadmap lives in the server's database, never here.

versions.goal: The first whole companion: draft helper, loading-screen scouting, profiles with grades, stats pages, imports and liquid glass.
What the first sessions on a real client asked for, the website, and the production-key application.
Proven on real machines and ready for players: a live stats server, a signed first release, calibrated numbers.

versions.name: Later
versions.goal: Worth doing once the basics hold, or kept open by the owner's calls.

features.title: Home: your profile from the League client
features.description: Rank, LP and recent games read from your own client, with no server in between.

features.title: Draft: a pick helper made of statistics only
features.description: Live champion select; picks for your role that start from your pool (mastery, your games), each with its reasons. No ban suggestions, no AI.

features.title: Draft insights: both teams' compositions
features.description: Damage mix, frontline, crowd control and game length for both teams as they pick; ARAM's bench ranked by your team's chances (job 9).

features.title: Live: loading-screen cards for all ten players
features.description: Rank, main roles and recent form of everyone in the game, looked up on our server; positive or neutral tags only, streamer mode respected.

features.title: Scouting by Riot ID, never by the client's PUUIDs
features.description: Client PUUIDs never leave the app; the server resolves Riot IDs with account-v1 and matches cards back to seats (job 3).

features.title: Player search and player pages
features.description: A fast, stable Riot ID search in the title bar (Ctrl+K) and a page with the player's rank and recent games.

features.title: Tier list and Champions pages
features.description: Per-patch tiers, builds, runes, spells, skill order, items and matchups, from our own Emerald+ aggregates.

features.title: Live: the My build tab
features.description: The build and skill order of your champion and role for the game's mode, next to the game (no overlay).

features.title: Build imports: rune page, item set, summoner spells
features.description: MVP's own rune page and item set (yours are never touched), spells with Flash on your key, never in a turn's last 5 seconds.

features.title: Match insights: a grade for every game
features.description: S+ to C with the facts that moved it, and the whole game behind each match row (job 10).

features.title: Settings and automations
features.description: Auto-accept (opt-in, with a delay, never after a decline), imports, stats rank, the window follows the game, close to tray, launch at startup.

features.title: English and French
features.description: Every word in typed catalogues, Windows' language by default, French Data Dragon names (job 7).

features.title: Liquid glass and ambient light
features.description: Glass that refracts the page behind it, light sampled from champion art, and Full / Light / Off effects in Settings (job 2).

features.title: Riot's ranked emblems, MVP's crest meanwhile
features.description: The client's emblems downloaded at run time and cropped to the crest; MVP's own crest when they aren't there yet (job 8).

features.title: Self-updates, remote config and crash reports
features.description: Signed updates with staged rollouts, kill switches and banners from the server, opt-in crash reports scrubbed of personal data (jobs 1 and 6).

features.title: Backend: profiles, scouting, match details, stats files
features.description: The only holder of the Riot key: cached profiles and matches, scouting batches, published stats, rate limits per install.

features.title: Crawler and aggregates, Emerald+
features.description: Ranked and ARAM games into per-patch tier lists, builds, matchups and priors; resumable and idempotent.

features.title: Diagnostics and logs
features.description: Settings → About copies a diagnostic with personal data removed and opens the log folder.

links.label: HANDOFF · Verify with the real client

features.title: Riot's red lines, by construction
features.description: Hidden players are never read, nothing during the game gives an edge, streamer mode is respected; `policy.md` answers for every feature.

features.title: Settings search
features.description: Finds a setting by what players call it, not only by its label.

features.title: Champion list: sorted and grouped by tier
features.description: Sort by tier, pick rate or name, groups that read like a tier list, a filter as you type; a flex pick shows in each of its roles.

features.title: Tier list hub: Shelves, Table and meta map
features.description: The champion list folds into one hub for tiers and builds: shelves per tier, a sortable table and a map of the meta.

features.title: Tier list: roles and reliability
features.description: A shared role rail, and how sure each tier is (the games behind it, its confidence) shown next to it.

links.label: decisions · Champion list (the shared role picker)

features.title: Live names from Spectator-V5
features.description: Riot's live game names the players (streamer mode applied by Riot), the game's own list when Riot has none; names before cards.

features.title: Auto import once, then warn
features.description: One switch per part: imports once at the first lock-in; a later trade, reroll or role swap only warns, with a one-click import.

features.title: “League client not responding”
features.description: A state of its own (amber) when another app holds the client's connections; Home waits and loads by itself once it answers.

features.title: Your games' roles, worked out per team
features.description: The most likely role of each player, from role shares, Smite, lane minions and support items, not the client's guess.

features.title: Window zoom: Ctrl +/−/0 and Ctrl+wheel
features.description: Zoom the whole window like a browser, remembered with the settings.

features.title: Skill order: what to max, and the first levels
features.description: The ability to max first and second, and the opening levels, on champion pages and in Live.

features.title: Glass you see through
features.description: Less frost and more bend, a soft gradient, smooth rims; Full follows Windows' transparency switch unless you pick it.

features.title: Updates from GitHub releases
features.description: Installers on GitHub Releases, and one command (`scripts/setup-updates.mjs`) to set up the update key.

features.title: Designed hover cards for runes, items and spells
features.description: What each rune, shard, summoner spell and item does, on hover or focus, in a card of its own instead of a browser tooltip.

features.title: The opened game as a sheet of glass
features.description: An in-window sheet of liquid glass with every player's end-of-game stats table; scroll down to close, player names open their pages. Grew into the game windows (2026-09-30).

features.title: Post-game summary, LP per game, history filters
features.description: The last game's summary card, LP won or lost per ranked game, filters by queue and champion, older games on demand, mastery on the profile.

features.title: ARAM: Mayhem augments
features.description: Augment tiers written by hand, popularity from players who opt in (pick rate only, never win rates), a champion's augment priorities.

features.title: The website on mvpgg.com
features.description: What MVP does, the download, every version, privacy and terms, in English and French (`site/`). Putting it online with the legal drafts read is on the Riot application's checklist.

features.title: Production Riot key: the application
features.description: The checklist: the site live with riot.txt, a public installer, a 2–3 minute video, Riot's current policy re-read, the product under a group.

features.title: The stats server live at api.mvpgg.com
features.description: The backend and the crawler timer on the VPS, then `MVP_BACKEND_URL` for CI and release builds, so builds stop showing empty stats.

features.title: This roadmap, at dev.mvpgg.com
features.description: Every feature by version for the repository's admins, Claude's proposals to accept or reject, and an audit log of every change.

features.title: A newer MVP takes over from the one in the tray
features.description: Starting a new build while an old one sits in the tray shows the new one; About and the diagnostics say which commit runs.

features.title: First signed release
features.description: The update key made once on the owner's machine, then a version tag: release.yml publishes the signed installer and later versions install themselves.

features.title: The real-client checklist, on Windows
features.description: Client fields, imports, live names, grades, the emblems' crop, updates and footprint, checked on a real League client.

links.label: HANDOFF · Verify with the real client

features.title: Glass frame times on real GPUs
features.description: Scrolling under the title bar and the rail's lens at 100 % and 150 % scaling, on an iGPU; Full stays off where the backdrop is slow.

features.title: Design review of the match screens
features.description: Screenshots and the ui-reviewer on match rows, the opened game at 420 → 2560 px, the grade's why and French; fix P0 and P1.

features.title: Calibrate grades on crawled games
features.description: Each role should average 5 and S+ stay rare: role shares, kill-participation offsets and scales in `grade.rs`.

features.title: Calibrate the draft model and composition readings
features.description: The model (research D §3.14), damage-type and frontline thresholds, and ARAM's length buckets, on real data (jobs 4 and 9).

features.title: Crawl again, and check the published files against the pages
features.description: Older games lack the composition numbers; check file sizes, thin Master+ data and sections with n = 0 on the real pages.

features.title: Bundle savings before the next feature
features.description: Lazy views list startup files again in their preload lists, and shared startup code splits into new chunks: win back room under the budgets.

features.title: Tier list trends
features.description: This patch against the last: arrows on win and pick rates.

features.title: After-game graphs and animations
features.description: Gold, damage and experience over the game once it ends, drawn with motion that plays once and then rests.

features.title: Updater: require the signed version
features.description: Once the CLI's signatures carry the version, refuse a manifest that pairs a new version with an older installer (job 6).

features.title: The owner reads the French screens
features.description: Wording that doesn't sound like the French client, and the unsure terms the i18n report lists (Swiftplay, roles, shard rows).

features.title: What Match-V5 sends for hidden players today
features.description: We treat a participant without riotIdGameName as hidden; check it against Riot's current answers before the production key.

features.title: Uptime alerts for api.mvpgg.com
features.description: A check of `/health` every few minutes (Cloudflare's health checks or a timer elsewhere) that tells the owner when the API stops answering, before players do.

features.title: Nightly backups off the server
features.description: The crawler's store, the backend's data dir and this roadmap's database, copied off the VPS every night (R2, or the owner's PC), with a restore tried once.

features.title: Say how fresh the stats are
features.description: The patch, the games counted and the last crawl next to the numbers on stats pages and in Draft, so old or thin data is obvious at a glance.

features.title: How the draft helper ranks picks, in one page
features.description: Plain words on the model (additive log-odds, shrinkage, the games behind each number), linked from Draft's why and from the website.

features.title: A keyboard and screen-reader pass
features.description: Every view usable from the keyboard with a visible focus, labels on icon buttons, contrast checked, at 400 → 2560 px.

features.title: Heatmaps
features.description: Where deaths, kills and wards happen on the map, from the Match-V5 timelines the crawler already reads.

features.title: In-game overlay
features.description: Not wanted yet (owner, checkpoint 2); the architecture stays ready for it.

features.title: Regions beyond EUW
features.description: EUNE, NA, KR and the rest once the pipeline is proven on EUW (and the production key allows it).

features.title: Stats files on Cloudflare R2
features.description: The published aggregates served from R2 next to the VPS (the crawler's optional upload already writes them).

features.title: What changed for your pool this patch
features.description: When a patch lands, the win and pick rate moves of the champions you play, in one card on Home.

features.title: Your own matchup notes
features.description: A line you write per matchup, shown in Draft when that matchup comes up; kept on your PC only.

features.title: Commits that link themselves to the roadmap
features.description: `roadmap#12` in a commit message adds the commit to feature 12 (a GitHub webhook, or `scripts/roadmap.mjs` after a push).

features.title: Player profiles on the website
features.description: The profile and match pages in a browser, from the same backend (the app's transport already has room for HTTP).

features.title: Ban suggestions in Draft
features.description: Rejected by the owner at checkpoint 2: the draft helper doesn't tell anyone what to ban.

features.title: AI or machine-learned picks
features.description: Rejected by the owner: the draft helper is statistics only, with a why for every number.

features.title: Live: bots in custom and co-op games
features.description: Riot's live game and the client's own session list only the humans of a game with bots, so Live shows them alone (seen in a custom game on 2026-09-29). Fill the missing seats from the game's own Live Client Data API (`allPlayers`, `isBot`) when Riot's list is shorter than the game.

features.title: Imports: say when another app also auto-imports
features.description: On the owner's PC, DPM's app imported its own rune page after MVP's and made it current (2026-09-29). MVP never re-imports or reads the player's pages to warn, by design; a one-time note in Settings > Imports ("another companion may also import at lock-in: keep one") would explain it without watching anything.

features.title: Live cards within the API key's rate limit
features.description: In a real game (2026-09-29) all ten names came in 5 s but the cards' batch answered 504 after 30 s on the development key (about 90 calls cold for ten players, 100 allowed per 2 minutes). The production key fixes most of it; until then, names first and cards as the budget allows, cached for the game.

features.title: Mayhem: "gathering data" with a progress bar
features.description: Owner, 2026-09-30: no hand-written tiers for now, "we simply have to get games going". Until the shared games cover enough, every Mayhem view says so kindly and shows a progress bar: games gathered against what full coverage needs (every champion, every augment), so players know when the percentages switch on.

features.title: Mayhem: percentages from your own games first
features.description: Read every ARAM: Mayhem game in the player's client history (ten players each: champions, augments, final items; no names, no results) and start the pick rates from them, sent once the player says yes to sharing. The owner's games are the first data.

features.title: First start: one simple question about game data
features.description: On first start, one easy-to-read screen asks whether to share game data: it is only game data (champions, augments, items; no names, no results) to improve MVP's percentages and switch features on. It shows a progress bar for every feature still waiting for data. Off until the player says yes; changeable in Settings.

features.title: Game windows you scroll between
features.description: Owner, 2026-09-30: the game view is a near full-size glass window over the page, one per game; scrolling carries you from one game to the next (a stack in history order), the page stays visible behind. It opens by itself on the game that just ended (replacing the "Your last game" card) and on any game you click.

links.label: decisions · Opened games are a stack of windows

features.title: Mayhem: every player's augments in the game window
features.description: Your client records each player's augments in Mayhem games (playerAugment1..6); show them in the game window with the same hover cards as items.

features.title: Website: live on mvpgg.com
features.description: Deploy site/ with the Caddy block from site/README.md once the owner fills in the legal pages (name, country, contact e-mail, governing law) and picks the hosting; then Riot's riot.txt after the product is registered.
